t='.......(.(.(.(.(.((.((.(....).)).)).).).).).)'
pairs=[]
stack=[]
for i,c in enumerate(t):
    if c=='(': stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop(); pairs.append((j,i))
seq=['A']*len(t)
for (i,j) in pairs:
    seq[i]='G'; seq[j]='C'
s=''.join(seq)
print(s)
print(len(s))
"
